# okstatus_alert_channels (Data Source)

Every alert channel already configured in the org that owns the configured API key — read-only, useful to check what exists before adding more. `config` (e.g. the webhook URL, which is sensitive) is intentionally not exposed here — use `okstatus_alert_channel`'s own state if you manage a channel as a resource and need its config back.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okstatus_alert_channels" "all" {}

output "alert_channel_count" {
  value = data.okstatus_alert_channels.all.total
}

output "has_discord_channel" {
  value = contains([for c in data.okstatus_alert_channels.all.channels : c.type], "discord")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) One entry per alert channel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier — this data source has no single ID of its own, required by the Terraform plugin framework.
- `total` (Number) Number of alert channels currently configured in the org.

### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `type` (String)
